rows.note: Use 忙 as the all-purpose choice when someone is occupied or unavailable.

example.english: I'm engaged with work right now, so I can't reply to you yet.
example.traditional: 我而家好忙，未得閒覆你。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 hou2 mong4 mei6 dak1 haan4 fuk1 nei5

rows.note: Use 有興趣 when someone is engaged because they are interested in something.

example.english: Are you engaged with this course?
example.traditional: 你對呢個課程有興趣嗎？
example.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 jau5 hing3 ceoi3 maa3

rows.note: Use 忙線 specifically for a telephone line that is already in use.

example.english: The phone is engaged, so I'll call again later.
example.jyutping: din6 waa2 mong4 sin3 ngo5 ci4 di1 zoi3 daa2
